flow_method: estimated from each home's net power (demand minus delivered solar); losses ignored

provenance.solar: modeled: live solar v2 forecast (manifest value for post_monsoon (per-season width))
provenance.demand: modeled: live day-ahead demand, pattern only model
provenance.voltage: modeled: live day-ahead grid voltage, pattern only model
provenance.grid: benchmark: SimBench topology with IS 398 conductors; homes on single phases
provenance.anchor: pattern only: the UP anchor needs yesterday plus five of the seven days before (scripts/record_up_demand.py)
